justification: Inspected zxing.appspot.com/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/web/generator/client/Generator.java, CalendarEventGenerator.java, ContactInfoGenerator.java, EmailGenerator.java, TextGenerator.java, UrlGenerator.java, WifiGenerator.java, GeneratorSource.java, Validators.java, and zxing.appspot.com/src/main/resources/com/google/zxing/web/generator/Generator.gwt.xml. The package is the GWT entry point and its classes depend outward on many GWT UI/event/date/i18n APIs plus local helpers, but a repository-wide search found no Java source outside this package importing or referencing these client classes, so there is no evidence that this package depends on less-stable packages while itself being more stable.
